observations: Three photos show two identical car headlight assemblies lying side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlamps have a modern design with clear lenses, black plastic housings, and integrated turn signals.
Each headlamp has a circular main bulb, a smaller auxiliary bulb, and a horizontal LED strip below.
The left side of each headlamp has an amber turn signal section.
The right side has a black plastic housing with mounting points and electrical connectors.
The photos are taken from slightly different angles, showing the front and side profiles.
A watermark 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' is visible across all photos.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlamps themselves.

claims.claim: All models of cars accessories available
claims.evidence: The photos show only one headlamp assembly; no other accessories are visible. The claim is broad and cannot be verified from the images alone.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlamps may be non-functional or damaged internally.
risks.proof: A video showing the headlamps being powered on and tested for brightness and functionality.

risks.risk: The headlamps may be counterfeit or not compatible with the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number or VIN tag on the back of the headlamp assembly, or a photo showing the headlamp installed on a vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or unknown compatibility

risks.risk: The headlamps may have hidden damage to the internal components (e.g., cracked lenses, broken bulbs).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components, including the bulb sockets and lens clarity.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the part number or VIN tag on the back of the headlamp assembly.
A video showing the headlamps being powered on and tested for functionality.
Close-up photos of the internal components, including the bulb sockets and lens clarity.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
